+from unittest import mock
+
+import pytest
+from click.testing import CliRunner
+
+import dotenv
+from dotenv.cli import cli
+
+
+KEY_CASES = [
+    ("plain", "plain"),
+    ("APP NAME", "'APP NAME'"),
+    ("#TAG", "'#TAG'"),
+    ("A#B", "'A#B'"),
+    ("A=B", "'A=B'"),
+    (" spaced ", "' spaced '"),
+    ("\t", "'\t'"),
+    ("a\u00a0b", "'a\u00a0b'"),
+    ("back\\ key", "'back\\ key'"),
+    ('"name"', '"name"'),
+    ("export", "export"),
+]
+
+
+def assignment(key_out, value, mode, export):
+    quoted = mode == "always" or (mode == "auto" and not value.isalnum())
+    value_out = "'" + value + "'" if quoted else value
+    prefix = "export " if export else ""
+    return prefix + key_out + "=" + value_out + "\n"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("key,key_out", KEY_CASES)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("mode", ["always", "auto", "never"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("export", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("value", ["plain", "two words"])
+def test_key_spelling_and_library_lifecycle(tmp_path, key, key_out, mode, export, value):
+    path = tmp_path / ".env"
+    expected = assignment(key_out, value, mode, export)
+    assert dotenv.set_key(path, key, value, quote_mode=mode, export=export) == (
+        True, key, value
+    )
+    assert path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") == expected
+    assert dotenv.get_key(path, key) == value
+    assert dotenv.dotenv_values(path) == {key: value}
+    path.write_text("KEEP=ok\n" + expected + expected, encoding="utf-8")
+    replacement = assignment(key_out, "next", mode, export)
+    assert dotenv.set_key(path, key, "next", quote_mode=mode, export=export) == (
+        True, key, "next"
+    )
+    assert path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") == "KEEP=ok\n" + replacement * 2
+    assert dotenv.get_key(path, key) == "next"
+    assert dotenv.unset_key(path, key) == (True, key)
+    assert path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") == "KEEP=ok\n"
+    assert dotenv.get_key(path, key) is None
+
+
+def test_key_append_preserves_unrelated_text(tmp_path):
+    path = tmp_path / ".env"
+    path.write_text("# keep\nKEEP=ok", encoding="utf-8")
+    dotenv.set_key(path, "A=B", "x", quote_mode="never")
+    assert path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") == "# keep\nKEEP=ok\n'A=B'=x\n"
+    assert dotenv.get_key(path, "A=B") == "x"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("key", ["", "'", "a'b", "a\rb", "a\nb", None, 7])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("exists", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("mode", ["always", "auto", "never"])
+def test_unsupported_key_rejected_before_rewrite(tmp_path, key, exists, mode):
+    path = tmp_path / ".env"
+    original = b"# keep\r\nA=x\r\n"
+    if exists:
+        path.write_bytes(original)
+    before = set(tmp_path.iterdir())
+    with mock.patch("dotenv.main.rewrite") as rewrite:
+        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+            dotenv.set_key(path, key, "value", quote_mode=mode, export=True)
+        rewrite.assert_not_called()
+    assert set(tmp_path.iterdir()) == before
+    assert path.exists() == exists
+    if exists:
+        assert path.read_bytes() == original
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("key,key_out", KEY_CASES[1:5])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("mode", ["always", "auto", "never"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("export", [False, True])
+def test_cli_key_lifecycle(tmp_path, key, key_out, mode, export):
+    path = tmp_path / ".env"
+    runner = CliRunner()
+    options = [
+        "--file", str(path), "--quote", mode,
+        "--export", "true" if export else "false",
+    ]
+    result = runner.invoke(cli, options + ["set", key, "two words"])
+    assert (result.exit_code, result.output) == (0, key + "=two words\n")
+    assert path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") == assignment(
+        key_out, "two words", mode, export
+    )
+    assert dotenv.get_key(path, key) == "two words"
+    result = runner.invoke(cli, options + ["get", key])
+    assert (result.exit_code, result.output) == (0, "two words\n")
+    result = runner.invoke(cli, options + ["set", key, "next"])
+    assert (result.exit_code, result.output) == (0, key + "=next\n")
+    assert path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") == assignment(
+        key_out, "next", mode, export
+    )
+    result = runner.invoke(cli, options + ["get", key])
+    assert (result.exit_code, result.output) == (0, "next\n")
+    result = runner.invoke(cli, options + ["unset", key])
+    assert (result.exit_code, result.output) == (0, "Successfully removed " + key + "\n")
+    assert path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") == ""
+    result = runner.invoke(cli, options + ["get", key])
+    assert (result.exit_code, result.output) == (1, "")

spec.question:
Extend `set_key` to serialize dotenv keys independently of the value's `quote_mode`. A supported key is a nonempty string containing no apostrophe, carriage return, or newline. Write supported keys unquoted exactly when the parser's `_unquoted_key` pattern recognizes the complete key; otherwise use its single-quoted-key syntax, preserving the key's literal contents. Unsupported keys must raise `ValueError` before `rewrite` is entered, leaving existing files unchanged and missing files uncreated.

Apply this key policy to both ordinary and exported assignments. Replacing existing assignments must still compare their parsed logical keys, and the returned tuple must contain the caller's original key and value. Keys containing spaces, `#`, or `=` must work with `get_key` and `unset_key`, and with the CLI's existing `set`, `get`, and `unset` commands, under all three value quote modes and both export settings. Preserve the current value quoting and escaping, unrelated file contents, encoding, and symlink policies. No new CLI options or CLI-specific error presentation are required.

Return a unified diff against production repository files only; leave tests unchanged.
